questions.q: Two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal. If one interior angle measures $(3x + 15)^\circ$ and its consecutive interior angle measures $(2x + 45)^\circ$, what is the value of $x$?
questions.answer: Consecutive interior angles are supplementary: $(3x + 15) + (2x + 45) = 180 \Rightarrow 5x + 60 = 180 \Rightarrow 5x = 120 \Rightarrow x = 24$.

questions.q: In a triangle, the ratio of the three interior angles is $2:3:4$. What is the degree measure of the largest angle?
questions.answer: Sum of angles $= 180^\circ$. Total parts $= 2 + 3 + 4 = 9$. Each part $= \frac{180}{9} = 20^\circ$. The largest angle is $4 \times 20^\circ = 80^\circ$.

questions.q: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular octagon?
questions.answer: Formula for interior angle of regular $n$-gon: $\frac{(n - 2) \times 180^\circ}{n}$. For $n = 8$: $\frac{6 \times 180^\circ}{8} = \frac{1080^\circ}{8} = 135^\circ$.

questions.q: In a right triangle, the hypotenuse has length $25$ cm and one leg has length $7$ cm. What is the length of the other leg?
Two similar triangles have corresponding side lengths in the ratio $3:5$. If the area of the smaller triangle is $36$ square units, what is the area of the larger triangle?
questions.answer: Ratio of areas equals the square of the ratio of sides: $\frac{\text{Area}_1}{\text{Area}_2} = (\frac{3}{5})^2 = \frac{9}{25}$. Then $\frac{36}{\text{Area}_2} = \frac{9}{25} \Rightarrow \text{Area}_2 = 36 \times \frac{25}{9} = 100$.

questions.q: In a $30^\circ$-$60^\circ$-$90^\circ$ right triangle, the length of the hypotenuse is $16\sqrt{3}$. What is the length of the side opposite the $60^\circ$ angle?
questions.answer: Side opposite $30^\circ$ is half the hypotenuse: $\frac{16\sqrt{3}}{2} = 8\sqrt{3}$. Side opposite $60^\circ$ is $(8\sqrt{3})\sqrt{3} = 8 \times 3 = 24$.

questions.q: A trapezoid has parallel bases of lengths $14$ cm and $26$ cm and an altitude of $9$ cm. What is the area of the trapezoid?
The diagonals of a rhombus have lengths $16$ inches and $30$ inches. What is the perimeter of the rhombus?
questions.answer: Diagonals bisect each other perpendicularly, creating four right triangles with legs $\frac{16}{2} = 8$ and $\frac{30}{2} = 15$. Side length $s = \sqrt{8^2 + 15^2} = \sqrt{64 + 225} = \sqrt{289} = 17$. Perimeter $= 4 \times 17 = 68$ inches.

questions.q: A rectangle has a perimeter of $48$ meters and a length that is twice its width. What is the area of the rectangle?
questions.answer: $P = 2(L + W) = 2(2W + W) = 6W = 48 \Rightarrow W = 8$. Then $L = 16$. Area $= 16 \times 8 = 128$ m$^2$.

questions.q: A circle has a radius of $12$ cm. What is the area of a sector formed by a central angle of $60^\circ$?
In a circle of radius $10$ inches, what is the length of an arc intercepted by a central angle of $\frac{3\pi}{5}$ radians?
questions.answer: Arc length formula in radians: $s = r\theta = 10 \times \frac{3\pi}{5} = 6\pi$ inches.

questions.q: An inscribed angle intercepts an arc of $110^\circ$ on a circle. What is the degree measure of the inscribed angle?
questions.answer: An inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of its intercepted arc: $\frac{110^\circ}{2} = 55^\circ$.
